Hero.name: Ali Tunacan Onar
Hero.intro: Full-Stack Software Engineer with 5 years of experience designing and building SaaS products from scratch. I've worked across fintech, healthcare AI, fitness, and B2B platforms, both as part of product teams and as a freelance engineer leading end-to-end builds.

About.title: Full-stack engineer, end-to-end product builder.
About.p1: I design and build SaaS products from scratch - both on product teams and as a freelance engineer leading complete builds. My work spans multi-tenant B2B platforms, AI-driven workflows, two-sided marketplaces, and cross-platform mobile apps.
About.p2: What I care about: shipping products that actually work in production, writing maintainable code that won't haunt the next developer, and understanding the business problem before the technical one.

Work.title: Products I've built end-to-end.
Work.subtitle: A mix of greenfield SaaS builds, marketplaces, and rescues of stalled codebases.
Work.ctaTitle: Have a project in mind? Let's build it together.
Work.ctaSubtitle: Whether it's a greenfield SaaS, a B2B platform, or a stalled codebase that needs to ship, I'd love to hear about it.

Experience.title: Five years across product teams and freelance builds.

Services.title: How I can help.
Services.subtitle: Whether you're starting from scratch or inheriting something that no longer scales - I can take it from there.

saas.title: SaaS from scratch
saas.description: Greenfield builds - multi-tenant architecture, auth, billing, and the unsexy infrastructure that lets a product actually scale.

rescue.title: Codebase rescues
rescue.description: Taking over stalled or AI-generated codebases and shipping them to production. Refactor, redesign the database, fix the N+1s.

mobile.title: Cross-platform mobile
mobile.description: React Native + Expo apps with a Next.js web counterpart. Shared types, shared logic, one team shipping both.

consulting.title: Technical consulting
consulting.description: Architecture reviews, stack decisions, and second opinions before you commit to a direction that's expensive to undo.
